about_the_game:
Story Synopsis:

Time stop? Restraints? Hypnosis? Wall penetration? Invisible man?! You can even change the law?!
In this boundless world, unleash your supernatural powers to the fullest!

Office rooms, conference halls, hallways—wherever you go, you are free to explore and experience an unprecedented level of interaction!
The most free-action H-game is here!

How to Play:

Players can take control of your character and move freely through the environment, use supernatural powers, and use skills such as stopping time, placing traps, and full orgasms.
Skills are gained through points, or you can increase various values or even change the law!

Game Features:

🔹 Supernatural Abilities – Stop time, set traps, manipulate consciousness—all at your command!

🔹 Character Progression – Earn points to upgrade your abilities and unlock new interactions!

🔹 Law Modification – Break the rules, rewrite the world's laws, and shape everything to fit your desires!

🔹 Diverse Characters – 15 unique character types, each with their own personalities and stories!

🔹 Reward Modes – Unlock hidden content, challenge special missions, and double the fun!
Create your ultimate fantasy experience and explore a world with no limits!
